skill.name: nextjs-supabase-auth
skill.description: Guides integration of Supabase Auth with Next.js App Router, including middleware, callbacks, server boundaries, and cookie-based sessions.
skill.summary: Set up Supabase Auth patterns for Next.js App Router applications.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code on SKILL.md line 56. No semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed skill text.

content.value_statement: Next.js App Router authentication can break across middleware, server components, and client state. This skill guides Supabase Auth setup with cookie sessions, protected routes, callback handling, and token hygiene.
actual_capabilities: Explains Supabase Auth integration for Next.js App Router projects.
Guides setup of context-specific Supabase clients.
Covers middleware patterns for protected routes and session refresh.
Describes OAuth callback handling and session exchange.
Highlights token handling and server-client boundary practices.
limitations: It provides guidance, not a complete application scaffold.
It does not include executable scripts or automated migrations.
It assumes a Supabase backend and Next.js App Router project.
It does not cover every identity provider configuration.

use_cases.title: Add Login to an App Router Project
use_cases.description: Plan Supabase Auth clients, callbacks, and cookie sessions for a new Next.js application.

use_cases.title: Protect Server-Rendered Routes
use_cases.description: Design middleware and route protection that keeps sessions refreshed without exposing tokens.

use_cases.title: Review Auth Boundary Choices
use_cases.description: Check whether auth logic belongs in middleware, Server Actions, Server Components, or Client Components.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Auth Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add Supabase Auth to a Next.js App Router project. Cover client setup, cookies, login, logout, and protected routes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Middleware Protection
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my route protection plan for Next.js App Router and Supabase Auth. Focus on middleware session refresh and safe redirects.

prompt_templates.title: Handle OAuth Callback Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide the OAuth callback flow for Supabase Auth in Next.js App Router. Explain code exchange, session cookies, and redirect handling.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Auth Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Next.js Supabase Auth architecture. Identify token exposure risks, server-client boundary issues, and misplaced auth state.

output_examples.input: I need protected dashboard routes with Supabase Auth in App Router.
output_examples.output: A route protection plan that covers middleware checks, session refresh, safe redirects, and where each auth operation should run.

output_examples.input: My OAuth callback works locally but users lose sessions after redirect.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist for callback exchange, cookie persistence, redirect targets, and Supabase client context.

output_examples.input: Review whether my client component should read auth tokens directly.
output_examples.output: A boundary review that recommends server-side session access and avoids unnecessary token exposure in client code.

best_practices: Use @supabase/ssr for App Router session handling.
Refresh and protect sessions in middleware for private routes.
Keep auth tokens out of client code unless truly required.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on getSession inside Server Components.
Do not store Supabase tokens manually in custom storage.
Do not manage client auth state without a listener.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design Supabase Auth flows for Next.js App Router applications.

faq.question: Does it generate a full starter app?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and review support, not a complete project scaffold.

faq.question: Which Supabase package does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends @supabase/ssr for App Router integration and cookie-based session handling.

faq.question: Can it help with protected routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers middleware patterns for protected routes and refreshed sessions.

faq.question: Does it address OAuth callbacks?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers callback route handling and exchanging an OAuth code for a session.

faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
